title: GOONJ TI HAI ZAINAB KI SADA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
body:
GOONJ TI HAI ZAINAB KI SADA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
HOGAYA TANHA BHAI MERE KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
1. AOUN O MOHD LAAL MERE FAUJ E ADO SE AISE LAADE
YAAD AAYI BABA KI WEGA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
2. HAA YE WO PYAARA NANHA GALA TEER E SITAM SE CHEDA GAYA
SAHMI ZAMEEN AUR ARSH HILAA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
3. KEHTI HAI ROO KE ROOH E HASAN BEWAA HOVI EK SHAB KI DULHAN
MARAGAYA QASIM DULHA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
4. SIBTE NABI KA NOOR E NAZAR THA JO SABIH E PAIGAMBAR
TUKDE KALEJA US KA HUWA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BHAI MERE ABBAS SE JAARI QUWATE QALBE SIBTEY NABI
NAHAR PE PYAASA MARA GAYA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
6. UMMET NE BE JURM O QATA KATA MERE BHAI KA GALA
LAASH KO BHI PAMAAL KIYA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
7. BOLI SAKINA ROO ROOKER CHEENE GAYA MERE GOUHAR
BAAD E PIDAR PURSA YEH MILA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
8. KASIE BHALA ZAMIN HO BAYAN ZAINAB KI WOH AAH O FUGAA
AAYE THE JIS DAM SHER E KHUDA KARBOBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN
AZZ..Zamin Abedi.
